details: CONFIRMED (timed). bin/types-lint runs "uv tool run mypy==1.18.2" and "uv tool run ruff@0.13.3"; uv keeps its cache and
tool environments under $HOME (~/.cache/uv on macOS unless UV_CACHE_DIR or XDG_CACHE_HOME is set). With HOME set to a
fresh folder per test, every call resolves and downloads both tools again. tests/test_types_step.py runs it 4-5 times,
tests/test_gate.py's Inert fixture runs it through a copied gate, and bin/ci's inert probe runs the library tests a second
time, so the cost lands twice per gate. The gate time roughly doubled (1412 s vs about 550 s). Project principle 2:
waste that repeats on every run is MEDIUM and fixed before the merge. Size: 15 min.
failing_case: ~/.local/bin/pytest tests/test_types_step.py -q --durations=3  ->  5 passed in 408.81s; each test 79-86 s
(test_front_hooks_are_strict 86.36s, test_clean_copy_passes 85.24s, test_unused_import_fails 79.34s).
The same tests with the real HOME (python3 -m unittest tests.test_types_step): Ran 5 tests in 5.512s.
Gate of fd221e0: "library tests ok (1412s)", "inert ok (1240s)"; master's last 8 gates: library tests 523-728 s,
inert 669-819 s. Offline, every bin/types-lint call under a test now fails (types-lint: "no network for the first
download fails"), so the free gate goes red with no network. Should: these tests take seconds, as before, and run
offline once uv has the tools.
fix_hint: In temporary_environment (it is computed before the swap, so it can read the real values): keep uv's cache and tool
folders on the real ones, e.g. "UV_CACHE_DIR": os.environ.get("UV_CACHE_DIR") or os.path.join(real_home, ".cache", "uv"),
and likewise UV_TOOL_DIR / UV_PYTHON_INSTALL_DIR if uv tool run needs them; take real_home before HOME is replaced (pass
it in, or read os.path.expanduser("~") inside the function before the caller sets HOME). uv's cache is not ~/.claude or
pass_cases: 1. pytest tests/test_types_step.py with the default active: 5 passed, total under 30 s on a warm uv cache.
2. tests/test_temporary_folders.py still passes: claude_dir() and home_dir() are under the temporary HOME, the real
3. Under the default, os.environ["HOME"] is still the temporary folder (only uv's cache/tool location is carried over).
4. python3 tests/run_unittest.py and pytest give the same environment (one definition in tmp_default.temporary_environment).
reason: tests/test_temporary_folders.py:47 asserts UV_CACHE_DIR kept; fails at base (KeyError), passes at head; test_types_step 5 tests now fast.
findings.summary: Principle 2 (waste, repeats every run): the temporary HOME gives uv a cold cache, so every types-lint test re-downloads mypy and ruff: 5.5 s becomes 409 s, and the library tests need the network on every run

details: CONFIRMED by reading bin/ci and running the proof test under plain unittest. The change rerouted lib_tests (line 28)
but left rules_tests (line 73), the second unittest runner in bin/ci. The listed tests set their own variables today, so
nothing leaks now; but the default exists exactly for the test that forgets, and a new rule test added to the text-only
list would write to the owner's folders in the short gate only. Size: 10 min.
evidence: rules_tests() { local t names; names="$(python3 lib/relay_textonly.py tests)" || return 1
python3 -W ignore::ResourceWarning -m unittest $names || return 1; python3 bin/relay sync --dry; }
$ PYTHONPATH=tests python3 -c 'import tmp_default,unittest; tmp_default.patch_unittest(); unittest.main(module=None, argv=["u","tests.test_temporary_folders"])'  -> OK
failing_case: A change that edits only rules/*.md: bin/ci --quick takes the rules_tests path (line 72-73),
"python3 -W ignore::ResourceWarning -m unittest $names", with names from lib/relay_textonly.py (test_sync_refused,
test_session_profile, test_bench, test_paid_batch, ...). No patch_unittest runs there, so HOME, CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR and
RELAY_HOME are the owner's real ones. The same command on the proof test: python3 -m unittest
tests.test_temporary_folders -> FAILED (failures=1), while the patched runner gives OK. Should: every runner bin/ci uses
gives the default, as the brief decided ("a default, shared by every test").
fix_hint: Let tests/run_unittest.py pass its own argv through (names given: run them; none: discover), and change line 73 to
python3 -W ignore::ResourceWarning tests/run_unittest.py $names. Run from the repo root, names like tests.test_rules need
the root on sys.path, which python3 tests/run_unittest.py does not add by itself (it adds tests/): add it.
pass_cases: 1. tests/run_unittest.py accepts test names (python3 tests/run_unittest.py tests.test_temporary_folders -> OK), and
2. python3 tests/run_unittest.py with no names still runs discover over tests/ (the library tests step), same test count.
3. A short-gate run on a rules-only change (tests/test_rules_gate.py style) still records only "rules text tests" and
4. bin/ci's inert probe gives the same results as before (lib copies of run_unittest.py/tmp_default.py are in the tree).
reason: tests/test_temporary_folders.py:56 runs the runner with a name (Ran 1 test) and asserts bin/ci:73 uses run_unittest.py $names; passes.
findings.summary: the short gate (rules text only) still runs its tests with python3 -m unittest, without the temporary-folder default, so those tests run on the real ~/.claude and ~/.relay
